hypotheses.latent_object: K(a,b) = T(a,b), a binary kernel template with an S2 argument-permutation action
hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with K(a,b)=T(a,b). For T(i,j), apply identity and instantiate a=i,b=j. For T(j,i), apply the permutation operator that swaps the two arguments of K and then instantiate a=i,b=j.
required_assumptions: T is an undefined two-argument function
argument permutation is a syntactic swap of the two slots
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are the two elements of the argument-swap orbit of the same binary kernel T, so a single template with identity and permutation operators explains both non-identical terms.
